name: Build a Roller Coaster🎢
desc:
Create and ride awesome roller coasters! 🎢

🛤️ Buy Tracks 🔨
- Get the rarest tracks and build the longest roller coaster!

🫂 Build with Friends
- You can share build permissions with friends!

🛠️ Creative Mode
- Use a Private Server to toggle creative mode!

🌟 Your roller coaster generates money while you're offline!
